launches.body:
Happy Friday YC Family,

Today, we launched The New Normal, our new bi-weekly video show featuring the enterprise leaders actually deploying AI in production at scale. This 51 second video features one of our first customers graduating over 90,000 learners per year:

Sizzle clip: <https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7475888904307605504/>

And you can watch the full episode where he goes into detail about the use cases he has in production with us here:

Full Episode 1 with Kermit Cook (CEO, Penn Foster): <https://youtu.be/r8ge3VbVFoA>

Backstory:

My Co-Founder, Timur Meyster and I went through YC W19 building what became Career Karma, the largest career transition platform for people from non-traditional backgrounds breaking into tech. We made thousands of customer calls personally and managed third-party BPOs at scale. We learned the customer experience operating model from the inside.

The thing we kept seeing across our enterprise partners was the same. Customer experience teams stuck in reactive, inbound-first models. Tools that waited for the customer to raise a hand. And the customers who needed the most help were the ones least likely to do that on their own.

We pivoted to OutRival in 2024 to build the opposite. Over the last two years we have sat with more than 300 enterprise leaders across higher education, insurance, travel, and beyond, iterating alongside the operators running the work. Digital Workers that take the first move. That can run millions of outreach attempts a month across voice, text, and email, with the compliance posture a regulated enterprise needs. That can be onboarded into a team like a new hire.

The Show:

The New Normal is co-hosted by me, Timur, and our Head of Insurance John Henry. All three of us have built media at scale before. Timur and I previously hosted Breaking Into Startups, which reached more than 3 million people. John Henry previously hosted Hustle on VICELAND, executive produced by Alicia Keys and Marcus Samuelsson, which reached tens of millions. John is also a co-founder of Harlem Capital and Loop.

This time the centerpiece is our customers and the operators inside them actually deploying AI at scale.

As mentioned earlier, Episode 1 is with Kermit Cook (CEO, Penn Foster). Confirmed cohort going forward includes Presidents of WGU, Miami Dade, UMGC, SNHU, NU, and OU; CEOs of DeVry, Cengage, and Campus; plus senior leaders at University of Phoenix and UMass Global. More coming across insurance and travel.

15 episodes scheduled. 7 already recorded. Bi-weekly cadence starts today.

Asks:

1\. Operators for The New Normal show. We're recording 15-30 more episodes over the next 3-4 months across higher ed, insurance, and travel. If you know an executive operator at a Fortune 1000 company running real outbound AI deployments inside their org and generating revenue, send them my way.

2\. Please show love on LinkedIn ,YouTube, and Twitter (Here - <https://x.com/rubenharris/status/2070123138948399388?s=20>)

Thanks for reading. Hit me on Bookface or at [ruben@outrival.com](mailto:ruben@outrival.com).

Love,

<https://thenewnormal.fm/>

Ruben Harris

CEO, OutRival

name: GuruHotel
long_description:
GuruHotel is building the AI-native booking protocol that will power direct hotel reservations in the next decade, effectively becoming "Stripe for hotel bookings" and ending OTAs' $370B stranglehold on hospitality distribution.

For 25 years, hotel ecommerce has been broken. Independent hotels lack the infrastructure to sell directly online, forcing them to pay OTAs 20-40% commissions on 40-60% of their bookings. Hotel websites don't convert (<0.5% vs. 5-10% in modern ecommerce), booking engines redirect users, payments are fragmented, and inventory is trapped in legacy PMS systems.

More critically: AI agents cannot book hotels directly today. ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, none can complete a hotel transaction end-to-end because inventory isn't exposed in a machine-readable format.

GuruHotel has built the complete solution: a full-stack ecommerce platform (website + native booking engine + checkout + payments + AI-ready APIs) that integrates directly with hotel PMS systems, enabling both humans and AI agents to book directly.
one_liner: AI-native direct booking infrastructure for global hospitality

launches.tagline: Do you like free flights? We'll help you get *lots* of them in economy or business
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

[Pointhound](https://pointhound.com) helps you earn and redeem your credit card points for free flights to amazing destinations 🛫🏝️🗼

If you’re like us and like the idea of getting free flights _for free_, read on! 👇

# **🤫 The situation — and a big secret**

120m Americans have credit cards, but almost none of us know how to use them or which one(s) to get. We think that cash back cards are the best because they give us, well, cash back.

The reality is, instead of cash back, earning **points** when you spend will get you _far, far_ greater ROI than cash back — upwards of 10-15x, in fact, when you use your points to book flights.

Book flights with points, you say? How do I do that? Great question: by **transferring** **your points** from your credit card portal (like Amex) to an airline (like Delta) and booking with an airline.

Example: let’s say you found a flight that retails for $1000. If you booked that flight through your credit card’s travel portal, it would cost you 100,000 points (or $0.01 per point — the industry standard). By transferring your points from your credit card’s portal to the airline flying the route, it might only cost you 90,000 points. Not bad.

But If you booked the Delta flight through their partner, Air France-KLM’s website, **it might only cost you 10,000 points** — 10x cheaper!

_Yup, really._

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/Ybt3eTOD1Q5hY_qPmvTpU0Zr7PRHjgPk-esFb3v5pENdVIscLo6Nx1UQmHWCtw09Xl7m_Se3vOw4U-jXu-l7ChWZlejksxzGW-q-NmmL7Hm9YO5ECgCUfjRvBkq6TKvypbtIQpBDP0ozp8En53VjWSw)

# **❌ The problem**

Ok, so now we understand that earning points are better than cash back, let’s talk about the problem:

* Figuring out which point-earning credit card(s) to sign up for is complex.
* Knowing which card you should use to maximize the points you **earn** is even more complex.
* And figuring out how to **redeem** your hard-earned points for good, no, _great_ value may be the most complex.

Sure, there are the blogs and content-heavy websites that _try_ to help you navigate the world of points. But they require you to read and digest thousands of full-length articles to understand what to do.

And there are a few companies who have built flight search tools for points, but none seem to holistically address the complexities of both **earning** points and **redeeming** those points. Oh, and they also charge you a monthly fee.

# **✅ The solution — Pointhound**

[Pointhound](http://pointhound.com) is a _completely free_ way to help you earn and redeem your points for free flights 🏝️☀️

Our goal is simple: to simplify the complex world of credit card points and airline miles. We do this by providing our users with a few delightfully designed tools. Our tools help you:

**Redeem your points**. Not sure how to use your hard-earned credit card points? You’re in luck! Our flight search engine searches over 140 airlines at once and surfaces incredible deals using your points and miles. And our [Top Flight Deals](https://pointhound.com/explore) page shows you the cheapest flights from your home airport to destinations all over the world.

We then tell you where you should transfer your points from (ex. Chase) and to (ex. Air France-KLM Flying Blue) to get the absolute best deal using your points.

For example, I just booked a flight from SFO to Tokyo in business class for only 60,000 points, when the retail price was $6500 – more than 10 times cheaper when booking with points! _Now you can too._

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/G-JvDBpItFU2r2HzbXVzxX3jmIAv9YP8nluGgDZ5aFrRdvs20-jrNVTM6ygH38DBfCst80WZOCxapnecQY207t-7zeaHSbkQIJk26v39PM_3QJWNfWmVsxv4NYv8faNMhB12r7c7n7h7xS8xQmS79yo)

**Earn more points**. Newly obsessed with finding and booking free flights and want to get more points? Our personalized credit card algorithm helps you get the right card(s) for you so you can maximize the points you earn (and free flights you can get).

Our goal is to equip the “points beginners” – many of us who have a card or two and would like a simple product to help us earn and redeem our points for free flights.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/1Q51EUtGWI6LLfJtSPthI-q2QN2dSowTFKu_D8_KX5k957PRhe73c01FhSiEKK9wrrA2jymjG-bA-gUk5n91Ym-_-uV8Ywp9JkfrAlZMPWtgxot1uGm3BbNvMUZsEZh3i3B6CtFuWehXmDhbXKfk8eQ)

# **👨‍👩‍👦‍👦 Why us**

We’re a mix of point junkies _and_ point beginners. We understand our user, because we _are_ our user.

We can relate, but we also ask questions and listen. Learning from our users directly is critical.

We’ve seen industries in need of a shake up — we’ve been here before. Our founding team previously founded and built the consumer startup, [Feather](https://livefeather.com/), a YC S17 company, where we raised $75 million from Kleiner, Bain and NEA, and sold the business.

* [Jay Reno](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jayjreno/) 👨‍✈️ - Co-founder & CEO
* [Jake Malone](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jakemalone/) 👨‍🏫 - Co-founder & CTO

* [Jeffrey Flynn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffreynflynn/) 👨‍💻 - Founding Engineer

We’re combining our consumer experience building Feather with our passion for travel to build a once-in-a-generation travel business.

# 

# **🙏 Asks**

1. Find and book yourself a [free flight](https://www.pointhound.com/explore). _Is that a real ask?_ It sure is.
2. Share with your friends who you think might love booking free flights! _Thanks in advance_.
3. Please share feedback by sending an email to [founders@pointhound.com.](mailto:founders@pointhound.com) _But, like, pls don’t spam_ 🤞.

launches.tagline: Maximize the value of your credit card points and miles with the best-in-class award travel search engine
launches.body:
### **TL;DR:**

At [**Roame**](https://roame.travel/), our goal is to help you maximize the value of your credit card points and miles while reducing the work needed by 100x. 

Credit card points and miles have become so widespread that it’s essentially an $100+ billion asset class. Yet, the process to redeem those points for outsized-valued flights is quite convoluted. Everyone wants to redeem an international first class ticket for 70K points, but few know how and the process can take up to 30 hours to fully optimize. Experts know the tricks of redeeming points, but most people, including frequent flyers, do not.

### **⭐️ Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72364&key=user_uploads/1214689/fde7241e-261f-4e2e-8376-0834cd643e38)

Our First Class Japan Airlines flight from Tokyo to San Francisco, booked for just 70K miles each using [**Roame**](https://roame.travel/)!

[**Tim Qin**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/timqin/) **(CEO)** is a points and miles geek. He spent the last 10 years as a successful investor and operator in internet travel, financial services, and ad-tech companies, earning more than a hundred million for clients.

[**Zi Liu**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ziyuanliu/) **(CTO)** is a full-stack software engineer. He was most recently in charge of Airbnb’s encryption services, creating and managing billions of cryptographic requests.

### **❌ Problem**

1. **Data** access is limited and fragmented for points redemptions. What you find on the travel portals are oftentimes not the best deals.
2. **Time-consuming** to find flights and hotels to book using points. Can take up to 30 hours per trip to search across multiple loyalty programs to take advantage of complicated award redemption rules and that’s just for 1 ticket.
3. **Underutilization** of points and miles leading to dissatisfaction and churn. Chase / Amex portals allow customers to book flights using points-to-cents value on a 1:1 to 1:1.5 ratio, whereas the true value of points can only be realized through airline partner transfers where users can find points-to-cents value ratio up to **1:25**!

### **✨ Solution**

We built [Roame](https://roame.travel/) as the best-in-class award flight search engine, supporting 12 airline loyalty programs and delivering results in  seconds. We even one-up Google Flights by allowing you to search from multiple origin and destination airports including entire states, countries, and even continents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72364&key=user_uploads/1214689/673c55d7-864f-406b-b298-6dfdee20e42c)

We currently search for points redemption availability across these 12 airline programs and their partners airlines (180+):

 1. AeroMexico Club Premier
 2. Air Canada Aeroplan
 3. Air France / KLM Flying Blue
 4. Alaska Mileage Plan
 5. American Airlines AAdvantage
 6. Avianca Lifemiles
 7. Delta SkyMiles
 8. Emirates Skywards
 9. Iberia Plus
10. Jetblue TrueBlue
11. United Airlines MileagePlus
12. Virgin Atlantic Flying Club

### **🙏 Asks**

* **Sign up** for [**Roame**](https://roame.travel/) and search for **free**! Would love feedback or suggestions on how we can make Roame better serve your points journey.
* Connect us with **credit card issuers** (Chase, American Express, Citi, Capital One, Wells Fargo, etc.), **networks** (Visa, Mastercard, etc.), **personal finance gurus/apps** (CreditKarma, NerdWallet, CreditSesame, etc.), and **travel bloggers/content writers**.

Maximize the value of your points and miles with [Roame](https://roame.travel/) ✈️\
You can follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/roame.travel/) or [Twitter](https://twitter.com/roametravel). You can also reach us at [founders@roame.travel](mailto:founders@roame.travel).

**Tl;dr:** HostAI streamlines guest services, team management, maintenance, and marketing for vacation rental managers. We remove the complexity of management so managers can focus on providing great hospitality. 

Hi everyone, we’re Punn and Cole, the founders of [HostAI](https://www.hostai.app/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78716&key=user_uploads/1382533/4b1e29ef-79e7-4bac-9b2c-e335b5377539)

[Punn:](https://www.linkedin.com/in/punnkam/) Ex-Google engineer and proptech builder.

[Cole:](https://www.linkedin.com/in/colerubin/) Vacation rental manager and real estate developer. 

❌ **Problem:** Vacation rental management is hard

It’s like operating 50 different hotel rooms spread across an entire region. Each property requires its own processes, rules, and team members. Managers use 5-10 different third-party apps to manage everything effectively.

launches.body:
**TLDR:** Rove Miles is the first universal airline mile program. Earn up to 25x miles on everyday spend, hotel stays, flights, and through partner programs—all on top of your existing credit card rewards. Then, redeem those miles effortlessly across 12 global loyalty programs, 140+ airlines, and 200,000+ hotels at up to 90% off.

[https://youtu.be/LsYKowedGn4](https://youtu.be/LsYKowedGn4?feature=shared)

Hey everyone! We're [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxmorganroth/) and [Arhan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arhanchhabra/), founders of [Rove](http://rovemiles.com), and we're excited to launch the first universal travel loyalty program that works across almost every airline and hotel in the world.

Before Rove, we founded startups at Wharton and Harvard—connecting people through specialized Bluetooth software and revolutionizing edtech recruiting. Between scaling businesses and attending class, we traveled to over 50 countries for free in business and first class, leveraging credit card points and loyalty transfers. But our friends? They were stuck on the sidelines, locked out by complicated rules, outdated credit requirements, and high fees.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89835&key=user_uploads/815885/c7172baa-a6d9-48fd-89c4-deb60b29c891)

_Arhan and Max_

### **The Problem: Gaps in Accessibility and Usability**

Travel rewards today exclude millions, especially young people. Over 70 million Americans can't access premium travel credit cards, leaving a majority of Gen Z—the generation most eager to travel—unable to earn a meaningful number of miles and points across airline and hotel loyalty programs, which provide discounts of up to 90% compared to standard credit card travel portals. Unlike markets like Hong Kong and Singapore, where earning miles is easy and part of everyday life, Americans face unnecessary complexity and high barriers.

### **Our Solution: Rove Miles**

Rove Miles makes travel accessible and rewarding for everyone. We've unified 12 major international loyalty programs into a single, universal currency that's easy to earn (always on top of your existing credit card rewards) and simple to redeem:

* Earn miles on over 7,000 merchants by activating the [Rove Shopping](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rove-shopping/jkklhhheomgefgljanpobgabooknjlbf?authuser=0&hl=en) chrome extension before your purchase.
* Earn up to 25x miles on hotel bookings made through [Rove](https://rovemiles.com), which can be earned instantly for non-refundable stays to cover your flight there or add extra free nights.
* Earn 3x bonus miles on flights on top of the miles you get from the airline when booking through [Rove](https://rovemiles.com).

Soon, you'll also earn Rove Miles from dining, in-store purchases, and transferring existing points in from partner programs.

### **Rove’s Transfer Partners**

Rove’s initial loyalty program partners are:

* Air France-KLM Flying Blue
* Air India Maharaja Club
* Accor Live Limitless
* Aeromexico Rewards
* Cathay Pacific Asia Miles
* Etihad Guest
* Finnair Plus
* Hainan Airlines Fortune Wings Club
* Vietnam Airlines Lotusmiles
* Qatar Airways Privilege Club
* Thai Airways Royal Orchid Plus
* Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles

More programs are coming soon, with our current partnerships covering all three major airline alliances. With Rove Miles, your points become 2-3x more valuable compared to traditional credit card redemptions, even on hotels where high-value redemptions can be even harder to find. Soon, you will be able to use miles on unique travel experiences, such as events, festivals, private jet charters, or flying in zero gravity!

### **Join Us on This Journey**

We're building Rove Miles to make free annual vacations accessible to everyone, effortlessly. Stop missing out—turn your everyday spend into unforgettable travel experiences.

Stay tuned,

Max and Arhan

launches.title: Rove: Travel the world for free
launches.tagline: The first travel credit card for Generation Z.
launches.body:
**TLDR:** Rove is the only travel credit card for young adults, leveraging cash-flow underwriting and the first-ever travel points portal to allow the average Gen Z spender to effortlessly travel the world for free.

Hey everyone! We're [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxmorganroth/) and [Arhan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arhanchhabra/), founders of [Rove](https://linkedin.com/company/rovecard/), and we're thrilled to introduce the first travel credit card for young adults. Our journeys began at Wharton and Harvard, where we built ventures around specialized Bluetooth software to connect people at events and a B2B edtech recruiting platform for schools and startups. We scaled our ventures by day and slept on planes by night, traveling the world for free.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79108&key=user_uploads/815885/cf150984-2142-40ce-b084-59f3848706f9)

_Arhan and Max_

Despite travel-hacking our way to over 50 countries, none of our friends could do the same. The barriers? Stringent credit requirements based on outdated underwriting algorithms (FICO), ludicrous fees, and antiquated software systems turned the dream of free travel into a complicated puzzle. We may have been able to hack the system, but we always wished for one that didn’t need to be hacked and rewarded users by default instead.

### **The Problem: Gaps in Accessibility and Usability**

Right now, the travel credit card market fails to serve the people who want to travel the most. Existing cards are like computers were in the early 2000s: they work, but they’re expensive, many people can’t access them, and even those who can struggle to use them without help. We’re building the iPhone of travel cards—one that’s easy to use, readily accessible, and seamlessly intuitive. These two market inefficiencies create one of the best opportunities in consumer credit in decades.

### **Our Solution: Rove**

Rove is here to democratize reward travel, finally offering the first-ever no-annual-fee travel card for Gen Z. We use advanced algorithms and data aggregation systems to underwrite users in a radically more accessible way. By using people’s cash flow from connecting to their banks, as opposed to outdated data points like mortgages and decades of credit history, we can more accurately underwrite an entirely untapped demographic of users.

But we didn't stop there—we want reward travel to not only be available to young adults but easy to use too. Our platform introduces the first-ever portal for direct redemption of airline loyalty deals, making the process of traveling the world for free as effortless as it should be. With our alliance of partner airlines, the average Gen Z spender can earn a free annual trip overseas. Soon after our card launch, we’re leveraging better data and software technology to maximize user rewards across an accessible suite of financial products.

### **Experience Rove**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79108&key=user_uploads/815885/bd0013cf-e9b8-4bff-a03f-719f6ebcf17a)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79108&key=user_uploads/815885/6379bf8f-ebfb-4d4f-99e6-e36ba1f54d4c)

### **Join Us on This Journey**

We're on a mission to make the world more accessible to young adults everywhere by building a financial suite of products geared toward travel. In the short term, that’s our travel card. In the long term, it’s about expanding access to products globally that allow users to travel based on their spending and savings, leveraging our data flywheel to better underwrite the billions of underbanked people across the world.

If you're tired of missing out on travel opportunities because of credit barriers or complex points systems, Rove is for you. For now, our [waitlist](https://rovecard.com) is only available through the invite code _YCLAUNCH._ The first users to sign up will receive a Founders Edition of Rove.

Stay tuned,

Max and Arhan

launches.body:
We’re [Will](https://www.linkedin.com/in/w-weber/) and [Todd](https://www.linkedin.com/in/todsul/) 👋 and we’re building the first customer support outsourcing option for travel and transport companies that doesn’t rely on humans. Instead of massive offshore teams, Humoniq runs on AI agents delivering faster, cheaper, more helpful service.

We previously built [Flightfox (YC S12)](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/flightfox) where we grew revenue to over $22M annually, and ran support operations handling millions of customer interactions. That experience showed us how easily traditional outsourcing breaks under the pressure of travel’s unique demands, and gave us the conviction that AI is the only way to build something better.

[**https://youtu.be/Fzlotm1gQzw**](https://youtu.be/Fzlotm1gQzw)

# **❌ The Problem:**

Travel and transport companies spend billions on outsourced customer support, and the experience for travelers is among the worst of any industry. Long waits and frustrating conversations with agents who are underpaid, poorly trained, and burned out by repetitive work are the norm. These failures aren’t accidents, they are the predictable outcome of how the system is built.

Traditional business process outsourcing companies (BPOs) are designed to handle high-volume, repetitive work at lower cost than hiring a fully in-house team, but the tradeoffs in customer experience are steep. The model relies on large pools of low-wage, undertrained workers, and gaps in language or cultural context make interactions slower and less effective. For travelers, that means slow, inconsistent support and unresolved problems. For travel companies, it means unhappy customers.

# **✅ The Solution:**

We’re replacing the old outsourcing model. Instead of relying on massive teams of low-wage human workers, we rely on voice and text AI agents that scale instantly, operate around the clock, and deliver consistent service every time.

Our AI contact center covers both front-office support, for example, airlines handling flight changes, seat requests, or baggage questions, and also back-office tasks such as processing ticket exchanges, issuing refunds, and updating reservations. By automating both the customer conversations and the follow-up tasks, requests are resolved quickly and without handoffs.

For travelers, this means getting help right away and leaving with a resolution instead of frustration. For travel companies, it means keeping the efficiencies of outsourcing while finally delivering the level of service that makes customers happy.

# **🙏 Our Ask:**

Outsourcing is broken. It’s time to rebuild it with AI. If you know leaders at airlines, travel agencies, travel management companies, or large transport providers who care about customer experience, we’d love to chat. And if you’re an investor who wants to be part of replacing the old model, now’s the time.

Email: [**founders@humoniq.ai**](mailto:founders@humoniq.ai)

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Axelrod deploys agents in boutique and luxury hotels. Agents execute all non-physical front-of-house (FoH) and back-of-house (BoH) tasks inside the hotel's existing systems, just like your staff would, in order to deliver a hyper-personalized guest experience.

\
**The problem**

Running a hotel is a grind of manual, repetitive work. Staff are occupied with menial administrative tasks that do not directly improve the guest experience. Small operators burn their own hours on it, large operators hire teams. Either way it kills time or margins. Existing software is just one more thing to manage, it doesn't do the work for you.

<https://youtu.be/hFbl6zTruqU>

**How we solve it**

Axelrod maps the hotel's entire operation, then runs an agent workforce on top of it. The harness is purpose-built for hotel operations, powered by a memory layer that holds your property’s standard operating procedures and every guest’s history across stays, as well as an orchestration layer that breaks a request into tasks, routes each to the right role-agent and coordinates them across departments.

With computer- and browser-use, our agents drive the hotel's existing stack (PMS, POS, RMS) the way your staff do, with no MCPs, APIs, or integrations. That’s how Axelrod runs on the fragmented, legacy software real hotels actually use.

Axelrod augments every single role in the hotel staff: one butler can cover 4x the rooms. Because each agent has full context, it can adequately assess guest needs and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Agents start fully supervised and earn autonomy as they prove themselves, so hotels hand over the operations at their own pace. 

We’re trusted by Michelin-Key awarded hotels and live across four continents.

**Why us**

We both grew up in the hospitality industry and have worked on both sides of the desk.

**Our ask**

Intros to executives at hotel management groups, luxury hotel owners and general managers as well as hotel CTOs/CIOs.
